ana: Quick spin-up: microlaunch social post sprint + quick qual benchmarks before webinar. Need final landing copy pair for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Who can own?

mike: I can take Hosted & social cadence. Will draft 3 hero variants by EOD. :rocket:

tara: I'll do Dedicated + lead routing matrix with sales. Need the CTA options (demo vs trial) — preference?

ben: Recommend 'Start with a free demo' for Dedicated, 'Try Hosted API' for Hosted, 'Contact sales for Private' for Private. Also share benchmark one-pager for webinar.

ana: Ben pls add performance numbers: p50 latency, cost/unit, sample prompts. We want 1 slide for each mode comparing latency/cost/controls.

siobhan: I can run quick qual bench on 3 landing copy variants through our eval harness. Could use prompt set: onboarding examples + compliance q. ETA 24h.

mike: cool. For social posts, leaning short threads + 1 hero stat: 'reduces inference cost 2x' — need verified stat from bench though.

ben: Not yet verified. I'll generate microbench today, use `bench/run_bench --model redwood-10b --seq 512 --batch 8` and capture token/sec and cost. Tagging @infra for env.

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: bench infra job queued (#4721) by ben

tara: For routing: propose inbound form with hidden field 'deployment_interest' values: hosted,dedicated,private then map to SFDC lead queues: Hosted_PLG, Dedicated_Sales, Private_AE. Also webinar RSVP should set interest cookie.

mike: I can mock the form and CTA variants. Where should the webinar signup land? current webinar page or new landing?

ana: New landing that splits hero by mode but common webinar CTA. Also need UTM for social posts: utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=microlaunch_apr

siobhan: After run, I'll post a shortlist of winner copy: 3 lines per variant + quality score.

ben: Once we have copy winners, I'll wire into site and set canary on /landing/mode?canary=bench1

tara: :thumbsup: timeline? Webinar is in 2 weeks — need final copy + routing + social schedule in 4 days.

ana: Agree — deadline 4 days. I'll follow up with calendar invites. If blockers, ping me.
